::: {.callout-warning title="Preliminary output"}

This comparison is a diagnostic. It reads two previously-rendered
`analyse_predicted` runs — one per model variant — and shows how the
demographic / clinical distribution of the predicted-missing cohort
shifts when the underlying classifier changes. Interpretations should
be read alongside `docs/analysis/predicted.qmd`'s "Literature context"
and "Interpretation summary" sections.

:::

The two input runs are typically:

- **Left** — the usbc10 family (full feature set, including
  sociodemographic features).
- **Right** — the usbc11 family (clinical + maternal age only;
  sociodemographic features removed to probe selection bias on the
  `down_ind` training target).

Shifts that move *into* the literature-predicted direction — e.g.
Boulet's NH Black / NH Asian / low-education under-reporting — are
evidence that the left-hand model was leaning on demographic features
for reasons other than DS biology, and that the right-hand model
recovers the hidden signal.

```{python}
# | echo: false
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

config = json.loads(Path("compare_config.json").read_text())

left_label = config.get("left_label", "left")
right_label = config.get("right_label", "right")


def _load(side: str, variable: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_csv(f"{variable}_summary_{side}.csv")


def _side_meta() -> str:
    lines = []
    for side, label in (("left", left_label), ("right", right_label)):
        cfg = config.get(f"{side}_config", {})
        flag = cfg.get("flag_column", "?")
        pred = cfg.get("predictions_column", "?")
        src = config.get(f"{side}_source", "?")
        lines.append(
            f"- **{label}** — flag `{flag}`, predictions `{pred}` "
            f"(`{src}`)"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _render_compare_table(variable: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    left = _load("left", variable)
    right = _load("right", variable)
    merged = left.merge(right, on=["code", "label"], suffixes=("_l", "_r"))

    display_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Category": merged["label"],
        f"{left_label} (n)": merged["predicted_n_l"].astype(int),
        f"{left_label} (%)": merged["predicted_pct_l"].astype(float),
        f"{right_label} (n)": merged["predicted_n_r"].astype(int),
        f"{right_label} (%)": merged["predicted_pct_r"].astype(float),
        "Δ (%)": (
            merged["predicted_pct_r"].astype(float)
            - merged["predicted_pct_l"].astype(float)
        ).round(2),
        "Recorded (%)": merged["recorded_pct_l"].astype(float),
    })

    # Format for display.
    for c in display_df.columns:
        if c.endswith("(n)"):
            display_df[c] = display_df[c].map(lambda v: f"{int(v):,}")
        elif c.endswith("(%)") or c == "Δ (%)":
            display_df[c] = display_df[c].map(lambda v: f"{float(v):+.2f}" if c == "Δ (%)" else f"{float(v):.2f}")

    return display_df.set_index("Category")
```

    "is compared against the same recorded cases). The `Δ (%)` "
    "column is the **right-minus-left** share change per category "
    "— positive values mean the right-hand model over-represents "
    "that category in its predicted-missing pool compared with the "
    "left. `Recorded (%)` is the corresponding share in recorded "
    "DS births, shown as a reference anchor."
)

```{python}

_render_compare_table("mage_c")
```

## Maternal race / Hispanic origin (`mracehisp`)

::: {.callout-warning title="Headline comparison"}

Boulet et al. (2011) predict that infants of non-Hispanic Black
mothers are under-recorded ~5× more than infants of non-Hispanic White
mothers; Hispanic and "other non-Hispanic" groups show a similar but
weaker gradient. A predicted-missing pool that correctly identifies
the demographic under-ascertainment should therefore show **higher**
shares for those groups. A rightward shift (positive Δ) for NH Black,
NH Asian, and Hispanic under the clinical-only model is evidence that
the full-feature model was leaning on demographic features in ways
that suppressed recovery of those groups.

:::

```{python}
# | echo: false
_render_compare_table("mracehisp")
```
